items.how: Every row, modifiers, a few shortcuts.
Fn+Y, then type for a while.
Fn+E (BT1), then type.
Mac: Alt and GUI swap places, the top row is brightness/media. Back to Win: as before.
My Computer, Mail, Search, Home, media keys.
Fn+Left Win: the Win key does nothing and its LED is on. Again: back.
Fn+W: WASD and the arrows swap, a black blink. Again: back. Kept across a replug.
Hold Fn+Right Ctrl 3 s: Right Ctrl opens the context menu, a black blink. Again: back.
Follows the computer's Caps Lock, on USB and wireless.
Turns the volume, press mutes; a fast spin over 2.4G keeps every step.
Fn+L toggles the matrix and the side lights.
Fn+Del: next effect. Fn+-/=: speed. Fn+Up/Down: brightness. Fn+Left/Right: saturation.
Fn+Left Ctrl steps the side-light modes, the last one off.
Change the effect, wait 10 s, unplug and replug: same effect.
Effect, speed and colour change from Vial.
Hold Fn+E 3 s: pairs as "Akko 5075-1". Fn+R, Fn+T: BT2, BT3.
Hold Fn+Y 3 s: re-pairs with the dongle.
Fn+U from 2.4G: types over the cable again.
Fn+Y while on 2.4G: it reconnects.
A device key blinks while connecting and shows its colour once connected.
On 2.4G hold a key, unplug the dongle, let go, plug it back in: nothing stays held.
Fn+Space shows the level.
Cable in on battery: the charge indication; the computer shows the battery.
On 2.4G, 2 min idle: lights off. A key wakes it and it reconnects.
The computer sleeps: the lights go off. A key on 2.4G wakes the computer (the key itself isn't typed: accepted).
Fn+Space morning and evening on 2.4G, about the same drain as QMK or better.
The keymap loads; change a key; it survives a replug.
vial.rocks in Chrome on 2.4G: the keymap loads and a key change works.
Enter DFU, then Leave DFU, without touching the cable.
Goes to DFU, settings kept. Leave DFU brings it back.
Switch to USB with no cable, hold Esc, plug in: DFU.
Bench: Test crash recovery.
Bench: Test watchdog.
Hold Fn+Grave 3 s: keymap and lighting back to default, same device kept.
Hold Left Ctrl while plugging in: red, green, blue, white.
